findings.text: Nothing starts `TaskState --watch`: no file under Server/ or Servex/ imports or spawns it (grep), yet `tasks/readme.md` says "the dev server's side keeps it fresh". With no watcher, the page shows the last line of state.jsonl, so "22 min ago" and the ⚠ marks freeze (requirement 1, "the page tails it live"). Either wire `TaskState.watch()` into the dev server or Servex (as the doc's own Servex-hook decision says), or correct the readme.

The readme's "with no dev server running the page says so instead of showing stale counts" is false. The empty note shows only when state.jsonl has no line at all, and an old file still renders as if it were current (content: words must be true). Fix: show the snapshot's `at` age, and mark the view stale when it is over about 30 s old.

Each in-flight row's second line repeats its title as the agent id (`task-mastermind-dictate-next-4 · claude-sonnet-5-5`, shots/…-tasks/1920.png, band 2). The model alone, or the cost, would say more.
doc/architecture.md says "landed today = under today's session folders", but `landed_today()` also walks yesterday's folder. Make the doc say both.
The Lanes and Architecture tabs were not shot. Requirement 2 is judged from the code only.

At 3440 the List pane leaves 77% of the screen empty (layout.json empty 0.772): the detail pane stays blank until a row is picked. That is normal for Browse, but at this width Lanes would use the space. The readme already says so.

decision.text: Second view is a three-column state board (TaskLanes), not AITask Lanes (that draws subtask nesting). TaskState --watch polls the registry (no push); a Servex hook calling TaskState.write() would remove the poll. Browse unchanged.
